The original Type N-3B jacket was first issued to US Air Force crews in the late 1950s, developed to offer warmth and protection in the coldest and most extreme conditions. Drawing inspiration from traditional Inuit skin coats, the design featured fuller body coverage than a standard bomber jacket, with a thick wool lining that extended through the hood. This earned the N-3B the nickname “Snorkel Parka”, as when the jacket was fully zipped it left only a small opening in the hood for the wearer’s face.
Like all of our military jackets, the Iron Heart interpretation of the N-3B is not a strict reproduction model, but rather a heavyweight reimagining. Whereas the original military jackets would have been made with a nylon shell, we’ve used a hardwearing 12oz Japanese whipcord — the same fabric found on our N-1 deck jackets. BOLD London is a boutique eyewear brand born from a passion for crafting exquisite, impeccably constructed frames using the finest materials and time-honoured British artisanal techniques. Each pair is meticulously sculpted by hand from premium cellulose acetate. First, the raw shape is cut from a block, then filed into shape before heat is applied to manipulate the curvature. The frames are then buffed and polished by hand before undergoing an intensive tumbling process—for up to 48 hours—to achieve a flawlessly smooth, even finish.
Built for durability and distinction, one of BOLD’s signature design elements is the extra thickness in the front and sides of the frame, enhancing strength while remaining lightweight. This model is constructed using robust 7-barrel rivet hinges and fitted with Carl Zeiss mid brown gradient lenses, offering style and superior optical performance.

Our yokeless western CPO shirt, cut from 8oz Japanese whipcord. The origins of whipcord, or “jungle cloth,” are rooted in military apparel—a tightly woven fabric renowned for its durability and windproofing properties. The tough 8oz whipcord used to construct this shirt is woven using long-fibre combed yarns, creating a high-density, lightweight fabric with a smooth feel and silky appearance. As a CPO cut, this shirt offers a little more length in the body than our standard western cut, with oversized copper snap fastenings and additional hand-warmer pockets for versatility.
